label: ROBLOX MCP
description: Control Roblox Studio from Ducky. Wraps the official Studio MCP server plus Open Cloud (publish, assets, DataStores). One Assistant toggle, then drive places from the same uefn MCP.

settings.sections.title: Studio MCP
settings.sections.description: Open Roblox Studio, then Assistant → ⋯ → Manage MCP Servers → Enable Studio as MCP server. Ducky talks to Studio through %LOCALAPPDATA%\Roblox\mcp.bat — do not add a Roblox_Studio row to Cursor mcp.json.

settings.sections.title: Open Cloud
settings.sections.description: Optional. Create a key at create.roblox.com/credentials with Place Publishing, asset, and DataStore scopes. Stored encrypted on this device. Needed for publish / cloud assets / DataStores — not for live Studio editing.

properties.label: Open Cloud API key
properties.description: Creator Dashboard → Credentials → API key. Test introspects the key (enabled, scopes, IP).

steps.title: Enable Studio as MCP server
steps.body: In Roblox Studio: Assistant → ⋯ → Manage MCP Servers → turn on Enable Studio as MCP server. Open a place. Ducky already owns the connection — do not paste JSON into Cursor.

steps.title: Optional Open Cloud key
steps.body: Live Studio work needs no key. For publish, asset upload, or DataStores: paste a Creator Dashboard API key here and hit Test. Scopes: universe-places write, asset read/write, universe-datastores objects.
